activePlots.summary: The colony destroyed an Imperial outpost on day 655, waking the Shattered Empire. The Empire took the Ashford town of Dunwold on day 701 and is at war with the Ashford Compact. Severin, an Imperial defector, is advising the colony.
activePlots.publicHint: The Shattered Empire took Dunwold from the Ashford Compact

activePlots.summary: Severin defected from the Shattered Empire's general staff. An Imperial bounty on him has just been posted.

previousBulletins: Dunwold has fallen. The Shattered Empire took the town in a single morning, and the Ashford Compact took the news rather worse. Militias are said to be gathering at Harlow Ford.
The Empire has posted a bounty on a defector called Severin. The amount is large enough that I have been asked twice whether I know where he is. I do not, and I would not say.
